spans.s:
जिजीविषा जिजीविषा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt.
जीव्), desire to live.

जिजीविषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to live, desirous of
life.

जिज्ञापयिषु जिज्ञापयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid.
of Caus. of 1. ज्ञा), wishing to make known, seeking
to inform, communicative.

जिज्ञासक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Desid. of 1. ज्ञा),
wishing to know, = जिज्ञासु.

जिज्ञासन, अम्, n. desire of knowing or becoming
acquainted with, examining.
जिज्ञासनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, = जिज्ञास्य below.

जिज्ञासमान, अस्, आ, अम्, desirous of knowing,
inquiring, testing, investigating, proving.

जिज्ञासा, f. desire of knowing or becoming ac-
quainted with, inquiring; inquisitiveness; search,
investigation, examination, test.

जिज्ञासित, अस्, आ, अम्, investigated, asked, inquired,
sought.

जिज्ञासु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of knowing, wishing
to become acquainted with, inquiring, inquisitive,
curious, examining.

जिज्ञास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, deserving of being inquired
into, desirable to be known, worthy of being in-
vestigated; an object for inquiry, to be investigated
or examined.
